palette.name: crayola-blue
palette.role: Primary. Logo; brand-blue derives from it.

palette.name: vivid-tangerine
palette.role: Accent. Logo right bracket; brand-orange derives from it.

palette.name: strawberry-red
palette.role: Errors, as an icon, border or large graphic. Text uses danger.

neutrals.name: paper
neutrals.role: Light ground and text on a colour fill.

neutrals.name: slate
neutrals.role: Light secondary text and field borders.

neutrals.name: navy
neutrals.role: Light ink. Also the text colour on golden-pollen.

neutrals.name: fog
neutrals.role: Dark secondary text and field borders.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background and the ground the logo sits on.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and tinted bands. Text on it is ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on warning-fill in both themes (10.6:1). The warning band keeps this text in dark.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Input and button outlines. Meets the 3:1 non-text contrast rule (7.2:1 on paper, 9.4:1 on night).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers only, never an input outline (1.6:1 and 2.0:1). The solid values are the 30% mix, so they can be used without transparency.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Links, headings and interactive text, and the fill for primary buttons. A deepened crayola-blue (6.1:1 on white); lightened in the dark theme.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Orange text and emphasis on surface-100. A deepened tangerine in light (5.8:1); the raw vivid-tangerine in dark (7.1:1).

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand-blue fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons. Fill with sea-green for large graphics only.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Icons and text on a success fill.

tokens.name: warning-fill
tokens.usage: Highlight and warning backgrounds (golden-pollen). Text on it is always ink-on-warning, #14213D (10.6:1). Never use as text on a light ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, icons and destructive button fills (white text on the light fill, 6.5:1).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger fill.

tokens.name: logo-blue
tokens.usage: Logo artwork only: left bracket and person (crayola-blue). Same in both themes, about 4.2:1 on the dark surface, enough for a graphic but not for small text.

tokens.name: logo-orange
tokens.usage: Logo artwork only: right bracket and large graphics (vivid-tangerine). About 2.4:1 on white, so never small text.

tokens.name: logo-green
tokens.usage: Shield outline of the original logo only (sea-green). Not used in the simplified mark or in the interface.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Clear space around the logo at small sizes.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and logo panels.
